minutes.headline: Committee reaffirmed its MSBA preferred schematic for a new 6-12 school and named a CM-at-risk prequalification panel.
minutes.summary: The committee approved May invoices, heard the designer present the updated 6-12 school layout, site plan and early exterior massing, and reaffirmed its earlier vote on the preferred schematic for the MSBA. It appointed three people to the construction manager at risk pre-qualification selection committee, accepted a member's resignation, and reviewed schedule and outreach.

what_happened.line: The committee voted to reaffirm its approval of the updated preferred schematic for a new 6-12 school, for submission to the MSBA.
The committee appointed three members to the selection committee that will pre-qualify construction managers at risk.
The designer presented the updated layout, site plan and early exterior massing, and suggested concrete block and flat roof sections on part of the building for cost reasons.
Members were told that oversizing core spaces for future growth would not be reimbursed by the MSBA and would raise costs.
A call for volunteers will go out to replace a member who resigned, and the next meeting was set for July 24, 2013.

why_it_matters: The preferred schematic and the choice of construction manager shape the cost of a new 6-12 school, and the share the MSBA does not reimburse falls on local taxpayers.
Space built beyond MSBA-eligible size and material choices both affect the local cost, which voters would later be asked to approve.
watch_next: The pre-qualification panel meets with the OPM on Friday at 10 o'clock at TCP room three.
Next committee meeting: July 24, 2013, with email updates on design feedback expected before then.
